# CuteCode

> CuteCode is an open-source code screenshot tool and ray.so alternative. Create beautiful images and videos of your code with 65+ themes, publish snippets to shareable URLs, and remix other people's snippets. Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

## Documentation

- [Homepage](https://www.cutecode.app): Create beautiful code screenshots with the online editor
- [Snippets](https://www.cutecode.app/snippets): View and manage your saved code snippets
- [Pricing](https://www.cutecode.app/pricing): Free, Pro and Premium plans: higher-resolution exports, premium themes and fonts, watermark-free images and video
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/simpleneeraj/cool-snippets): Source code, issues, and contribution guidelines

## Features

- Code screenshot generator with 65+ built-in themes
- Brand-themed frames: Vercel, Stripe, Supabase, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Clerk, Prisma, and more
- Aesthetic themes: Aurora Nights, Neon Dreams, Golden Hour, Frosted Glass, Velvet Night, and more
- Syntax highlighting for 100+ programming languages via Shiki
- Export as PNG or SVG, copy to clipboard, or export GIF and video with typing animation
- Publish snippets to a unique URL (/preview/{slug}) and remix any public snippet (/remix/{slug})
- Public profile pages (/u/{userId}) listing a user's published snippets
- Dark and light mode with system preference detection
- Authentication via Better Auth (email and password, GitHub, Google)
- Responsive design: works on desktop and mobile

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Components)
- React 19, TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS 4, Radix UI, Base UI
- Shiki (syntax highlighting)
- Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL
- Better Auth (authentication)
- Dodo Payments (billing)
- Jotai (state management)
- Motion (animations)
- Deployed on AWS Amplify

## API & Integration

- Embeddable code previews via /embed/{slug}
- Shareable snippet URLs with full theme and code preservation
- Open source under MIT License
